entries.zh: 冤屈罪愆；冤枉加害于人，作孽犯罪
entries.en: sin and offense; wrong or injury done to another, transgression

entries.zh: 趁机；乘人信托之机而欺害、占便宜
entries.en: to take advantage of an opportunity; to wrong one who trusts another, betray a trust

entries.zh: 乘隙；趁虚而入，钻空子
entries.en: to seize an opening; exploit a gap or weakness

entries.zh: 残暴肆虐；以恶劣手段欺压人
entries.en: tyrannical and cruel; to oppress brutally, mistreat

entries.zh: 暴戾乖张；残酷苛待人（同 oprimir 欺压条）
entries.en: violent and ruthless; to treat harshly; same as oprimir (to oppress)

entries.zh: 酸；酸味的
entries.en: sour; acid, tart

entries.zh: 酸涩；指果实未熟而味酸涩口
entries.en: sour and astringent; tart, unripe

entries.zh: 崎岖陡峭；上下起伏之险地
entries.en: steep, rugged; rough rising or falling ground

entries.zh: 陡落；下坡崎岖
entries.en: steep descent; rugged downhill slope

entries.zh: 山路崎岖难以攀上；如缘壁而行，道路难行
entries.en: so steep and rough it is hard to climb; hard going as if up a wall, bad road

entries.zh: 陡峭如壁；崎岖成壁立之势
entries.en: steep as a wall; rugged like a perpendicular wall

entries.zh: 农业；农耕
entries.en: agriculture; farming, husbandry

entries.zh: 农具；亦指农事及其器具
entries.en: agriculture or its instruments; farm tools

entries.zh: 水
entries.en: water

entries.zh: 深水；深潭，深渊
entries.en: deep water; deep pool, abyss

entries.zh: 渊深之水；深如海的水
entries.en: deep waters; water deep as the sea

entries.zh: 蓄潴之水；沟渎水道
entries.en: impounded or stored water; ditch, water channel

entries.zh: 海上恶浪；险恶汹涌之海水
entries.en: bad waters of the sea; turbulent, dangerous seas
entries.notes: 汉字栏所录『蚱』与 M thê、R chō 对音不合，字未确考；释义据西语栏 aguas malas del mar（本页四见）。

entries.zh: 海上恶水；涌聚险恶之浪
entries.en: bad waters of the sea; treacherous, surging waters
entries.notes: 次字『蒲』（M phôu / R pǔ）对音相合，首字未确考；义从西语栏，与第18条同。

entries.zh: 海上恶水；回旋险恶之浪
entries.en: bad waters of the sea; dangerous, swirling seas
entries.notes: 首字对音第18/19/21条作 chō 而此条作 phō，互不一致，字未确考；次字『盤』对音相合，义从西语栏。

entries.zh: 海中恶水；险恶之海水
entries.en: bad waters of the sea; the sea's treacherous waters
entries.notes: 次字『水』对音相合，首字未确考；义从西语栏，与第18条同。
